## Slate overview
**Champions League Matchday 2, Wednesday:** Feyenoord v Como (12:45 ET). At 3:00 ET: LASK v Liverpool, Aston Villa v Fenerbahçe, Bodø/Glimt v Dortmund, Man City v PSG, Real Betis v Porto, Roma v Real Madrid, Shakhtar v AEK (at Stamford Bridge), Slovan v Stuttgart ([SI](https://www.si.com/soccer/champions-league-predictions-10-14-26-man-city-psg-real-madrid), [tips.gg](https://tips.gg/article/betting-digest-champions-league-2026-10-14/)).

**Feedback loop:** we're 8-10 and won 44% against 56% predicted. Yesterday's Atlético ML won 2-0, so soccer is 2-1 for us. In soccer the moneyline is three-way, and the Oct 5 lesson says to use a draw-protected market when a draw is live.

## Best bets
### Bodø/Glimt +0.5 Asian handicap (win or draw; -127, BetMGM) vs. Dortmund: 0.5 units
- **Win probability 60% vs. 55.9% implied.** 1X2 prices: Bodø 3.22 / draw 4.16 / BVB 2.15 (22bet). No-vig, that's Bodø 30.6% and draw 23.6%, or 54.2% for win-or-draw ([MightyTips](https://www.mightytips.com/football-predictions/bodo-glimt-vs-borussia-dortmund-prediction-14-10-2026/)).
- **The fortress:** Bodø have won 10 straight home matches ([tips.gg](https://tips.gg/article/betting-digest-champions-league-2026-10-14/)) and 5 straight UCL home games on their artificial pitch, scoring 3+ in each of their last seven home games. They've covered +0.5 in 17 of their last 20 games and 9 of 10 at home ([SportsGambler](https://www.sportsgambler.com/betting-tips/football/bodo-glimt-vs-borussia-dortmund-prediction-lineups-odds-2026-10-14/)).
- **Dortmund** are missing Emre Can, Lerma and Konstantelias (Ryerson's status is unclear), and they blew a 2-goal lead to draw 2-2 with Bremen. SI predicts 2-2.
- **Risk:** Bodø lost 5-0 at Bayern on MD1, and Evjen is out. The situational/venue angle has no track record with us, so it's half a unit.

## Leans & passes
- **LASK v Liverpool (Liverpool -1.5, -134):** pass. Liverpool are missing Gakpo, Isak and Szoboszlai and just lost 3-0 at home to City. Too short for a depleted side.
- **Man City v PSG over 3.5 (+106):** pass. We're 0-2 on totals, and SI predicts 1-1.
- **Roma v Real Madrid, Betis v Porto, Villa v Fenerbahçe (Villa 1.63), Shakhtar v AEK, Feyenoord v Como, Slovan v Stuttgart:** no verified edge.

## Risks
- Check lineups an hour before kickoff for Dortmund's back line and Helmersen's role.

picks.summary: Bodø won 10 straight at home on turf; Dortmund depleted in midfield; +0.5 covers win or draw.
